name: Trophy Satchel
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Slot —; Price 12,500 gp; Weight 100 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This sturdy, rugged satchel is made of exotic leather and seems sized for a giant. It functions as a bag of holding IV, but every organic substance inside is protected from decay, rot and other forms of spoilage indefinitely. The opening can stretch wide enough to accommodate even some larger creatures whole.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells gentle repose, secret chest; Cost 6,250 gp
